tasks.title: take: a left-over brief must not swallow --queued
tasks.why: briefs.py:523-525 (still, after the 2026-10-21 queued_on fix): take() calls left_over() and returns its (brief, note) before it ever looks at --queued/--outcome/--board. A session that reruns take with the unit it has just queued gets exit 0 and main prints 'closed with X (queued as <the OLD record>)', while the unit it names is written nowhere: the owner's yes is on record with the wrong outcome, and nobody is told. P1.
tasks.done_when: a test in Tools/assetboard/test_briefstates.py closes a brief with outcome words, leaves one open note of his, then calls take(..., queued='u-1') and asserts it either refuses or records queued='u-1'; red on today's code

tasks.title: player_bench.sh: fail when the player wrote no report
tasks.why: Tools/aosa/player_bench.sh:15-17 (unchanged since the 2026-10-16 review): rc from the timeout'd player is only echoed, and the last line is '[ -f report ] && echo ... || { echo NO REPORT; tail -20 log; }', whose exit status is tail's 0. So a crashed or timed-out bench run exits 0 and any caller or agent chaining on it reads a green where there is no measurement at all; bench.sh:15 does the opposite and exits 1 on no report. P2.
tasks.done_when: bash Tools/aosa/player_bench.sh lbl '' <a dir whose player writes no report> exits non-zero, and a run that does write one still exits 0

tasks.title: build.board_dir: say why the board could not be resolved
tasks.why: build.py:44-52 (new on 2026-10-21) wraps pipeline.board_dir() in 'except (SystemExit, Exception): return None', so every reason is swallowed. Its three callers then each guess differently: found.py:57 falls back to GH/'tw3d-board', src_images.py:28 and ops.py:202 pass the None on. A bad TW_BOARD or a shadowed 'pipeline' module therefore makes found.py write findings to a guessed board instead of refusing, with nothing printed. It also sys.path.insert()s on every call and never removes it. P2.
tasks.done_when: a test in Tools/assetboard/test_found.py makes pipeline.board_dir raise and asserts build.board_dir surfaces the reason (not a bare None) and that found.board_dir does not silently fall back to GH/'tw3d-board'; red on today's code
